scientific_integrity: Uniform-in-n assertions are proved analytically. Numerical experiments are diagnostic, not completeness evidence.
scientific_limitations: Finite-n mass function and multi-disk correlations are not derived; scope is regular planar polygons and fixed vertex-to-center diameter disks. Historical priority is provisionally assessed; independent audit is not performed.
title: Exact diameter-disk depth of a regular polygon: mean redundancy and a quantitative limit law
